description:
Goal
A first-class callable value captured by a continuation must be materializable from a transport publication lane (a single boxed value lane). Today it is shaped as a generic callable *contract* (ShapeDescr::Callable with function: None and zero capture lanes), which native cannot rematerialize.

Discovered while landing fz-hwn.21 (the phantom-surface grounding). With that fix in place, the Enum.with_index mapper repro clears the multi-boundary publication conflict and then fails native lowering with:
  native attempted to rematerialize generic callable shape ShapeId(N) in Continuation { owner: FnId(M), index: 1 }; first-class callable values must come from transport publication lanes

Why this path
Enum.with_index/2 lowers to with_index_list/3:
  fnp with_index_list([head | tail], index, fun), do: [fun.(head, index) | with_index_list(tail, index + 1, fun)]
The recursive call is inside a cons, so it is NON-TAIL; with_index_list builds a continuation that captures `fun` (a first-class callable). Tail-recursive Enum.reduce never captures its reducer in a continuation, which is why reduce works and with_index does not.

Root mechanism
- transport.rs: an EntryCapture position is made shape-equal to the captured Value position. The mapper value's shape is generic_callable_shape (function None, capture_lanes empty) -- the boundary CONTRACT descriptor, not a boxed VALUE.
- native.rs materialize_transport_value: ShapeDescr::Callable with function None is only handled when lanes.len()==1 (return the boxed pointer lane); 0 lanes falls through to the error.
- capture_lanes_for_callable_descriptor gives a first-class callable exactly one value lane. The two representations disagree.

Required work
- A first-class (boxed) callable VALUE/capture carries a single boxed value lane wherever it is a runtime value (param, continuation capture, resume payload); the 0-lane generic_callable_shape contract is reserved for boundary publication only. Fix where value/capture shaping and boundary-contract shaping are conflated; do not special-case with_index or continuations.

Checks
- fz2 interp on the with_index repro completes and dbg prints [\"a!\", \"b!\"].
- Re-enable compiler2_interp_runs_enum_with_index_mapper_from_backend_artifacts and pass for the right reason.
- Full lib + fixture matrix green, no warnings.

References: project_fz_callable_boxing_seam (one boxed value = one entry = one boxed lane); compiler2_branch_join_bug (non-tail continuation hazards).
title: First-class callable captured by non-tail-recursive continuation gets a 0-lane contract shape
